My memory doesn't hold what the owner required of OpenUI mockups for projects with their own design system, so I won't guess.

The closest thing I have is a commit title, 3fd3b6c22, "Mockups are OpenUI Lang over each project's own design system". It touched the Projects PRD, `OpenUiRenderer.svelte` and a new `mockup/` component set. That shows what was built, but not the owner's words.

Related owner statements I do have are:
- Components should be "just components and agnostic".
- "remember this needs to work for all our users, across their many languages and frameworks".
- He ruled out a proprietary format ("Ur not going to rewrite figma from scratch...").

The PRD file `.design-foundations/plans/2026-10-06-projects.md` would show the exact requirement.
